notes.title: Patch Notes 0.10.12
notes.notes:
Thank you for all the feedback over the weekend!
We have been reworking a lot of the central systems in the game this last few weeks which is making the game way more performant, but this also means the introduction of quite a few new bugs, but in the long term it's good for the game.
[b]A lot of the game breaking bugs has been fixed today.[/b]

It's also worth mentioning that some bugs are helped by running the "Validate game files" function in in steam.
And as always, if you find any bugs it helps us a great deal if you report them in our discord ( ourdiscord.com ).
Player logs are found in [code]%appdata%\..\LocalLow\Perfect Random\Sulfur[/code]

[b]Patch notes 0.10.12[/b]

[list]
[*] Bronco can now reload properly even if reload speed oil has been added
[*] Adjusted loot drop force.
[*] If aim is held (or toggled) when a weapon is reloaded, it will continue aiming after reload finishes. Useful for knop mains
[*] Novanian Guard now doesn’t spam attacks for no reason.
[*] Lingering Terrorbaum targets after fight now disappears properly
[*] Fixed Jaques De Fector dialog showing incorrect text.
[*] Fixed z-fighting on Town Civilian Woman.
[*] Fixed crash on loading.
[*] Fixed double weapon UI on death
[*] Fixed Novanian guard boss not moving.
[*] Fixed scopes getting rotated wrong over time.
[*] Fixed an issue that made the player get stuck in the crafting UI.
[*] Fixed not receiving crafted items if they couldn’t fit in the inventory. They now spawn in the world around the crafting station if they won’t fit.
[*] Fixed Black Guild Bishops sliding during shoot animation
[*] Fixed dead ghosts not disappearing.
[*] Fixed chests spawning inside other chests.
[*] Fixed some consumables not applying hp regen correctly
[/list]

notes.title: QoL of Life Update - 0.10.9
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=5vTwGxLqy4s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]We’re packing in a bunch of quality-of-life features and a cascade of small improvements that should make SULFUR smoother, faster, and more satisfying for y'all to enjoy! 

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cooking assistance: Easy-to-follow recipes for everything you’ve cooked before.
[*] Biggest performance and optimizations update yet!
[*] Interaction type icons now appear in dialogues, helping the lazy eye navigate quickly.
[*] New accessibility options: Toggle sprint, toggle aim, etc.
[*] Cleanup and improved weapon animations
[*] Toggle sprint and toggle aim options added.
[*] Player damage disabled in safe zones for less tragic deaths.
[*] The Church Collection Box now lights up when it has money in it.[/list]
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list][*] New Weapon: Neuraxis F22
[*] New Explosive: Proximity Mine 
[*] New Cookbooks: Unlock new recipes and remember the ones you’ve already discovered!
[*] New Enemy: Corrupted Lurk — Watch your step in the Sewers (we heard y'all were stepping a bit too easy).
[/list]
[h2]More Changelog Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] Railgun enchantments now apply correct damage and visuals.
[*] Knop received a full animation overhaul.
[*] Enemy footsteps are now louder and include landing sounds.
[*] Ugly candles should not be ugly anymore.
[*] New enchantment audio and fancy donation box particles.
[*] Novanian Guards now spawn in the Castle.
[*] Big enemies no longer squeeze into tiny spaces.
[*] Leaving water is now smoother and more reliable.
[*] AI improvements for better & dumber gameplay!
[*] Oils affecting reload speed have been tweaked to work better.
[*] Various bug fixes: Penetration Oil restored, Task Oil works properly, no more Z-fighting grass tufts, bounces apply correct values, and more!
[*] If you shoot a brick it now behaves like more brickly
[*] Falling out of the third story sequence no longer will soft-lock player in eternal hell. 

[h2]Known Bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Breached won't reset ammo in mag, press F and you can shoot again, it's a bit jank but will be hotfixed ASAP. 
[/list]
[/list][h2]Coming: The Fortress[/h2]
The next big update will introduce [b]The Fortress[/b]. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Performance Update - Patch Notes 0.9.15
notes.notes:
[b]Performance Update - Patch Notes 0.9.15[/b]

[b]We’ve been hard at work optimizing the game to ensure a smoother and better experience for everyone. While there’s still room for improvement, this patch brings significant upgrades that should make SULFUR feel better than ever. 🖥️✨[/b]

[b]✨ Improvements: ✨[/b]
🏃 Performance overhaul! The game runs smoother on all machines, no matter how ancient or shiny. 
🎨 Replaced all PNG sprites with SVGs, switching out pixels for vector art—think of it as upgrading from a 20-year-old Renault to a 10-year-old Volvo. Reliable, efficient, and just better.  🚗 🇸🇪
🖼️ Effects, environments, and levels have been reworked to be far less taxing on your hardware.
⏳ Loading times are noticeably faster. 
🔥 Melee enemies now also have the ability to use elemental effects! 
🔫 Bullet holes are now limitless and will never tank performance, and enemies stay above ground so you can spray away with confidence!
🌩️ Aftershock has been nerfed and now has a 10% chance of triggering instead of 100%.

☝️Note: Later areas like the Dungeon still need a bit more work, but the framerate is definitely more stable with fewer hiccups. (We know what more to do, but we just don’t have time right now because it’s Christmas, Swedish tradition demands us to watch Donald Duck cartoons and eat Janssons Frestelse, and we’re already neglecting our children/families enough as it is. 🎄🎅)

[b]🐛 Bug Fixes:[/b]
🐶 Dogs can no longer be cheesed by doing that little backstep. 
🗺️ Fixed an issue where item names didn’t properly localize in break notifications. 💬🌍
🦾 Stiffleg now correctly misses the right arm—not the wrong one. We’ve triple-checked. I think.
🌋 Fixed elemental damage from poison, frost, and lava unfairly stacking against you.  ❄️☠️🔥

[b]Additions:[/b]
🚀 The rocket enchantment is back! Use responsibly.
🐬 The Dolphin has been buffed—now deadlier, snappier, and hopefully more ready to make waves among y’all.
👣 New Enemy Mutation: Elemental trails 

💡 We’re still working out a few quirks, but this update should make SULFUR run smoother and your computer happier. Let us know how it feels!

[b]🌲 Future Updates 🌲[/b]
We’re nearing the end of the Fixing Shit phase and are excited to shift our focus to what’s next: adding more content full-time! 🎉 Here’s what you can expect as we dive into the next phase:

[list]
[*] Next Area 🌲 The Forest  will be the next area to expand your journey, complete with new enemies and challenges.
[*] More Guns & Magic: 🪄🔫  We’re hard at work creating new weapons and magical abilities to keep things fresh and deadly.
[*] And Future Areas in Progress  🏜️ 🏰  While working on The Forest, we’re already planning ahead for the Fortress, Desert, and beyond.
[/list]

notes.title: Warehouse Update
notes.notes:
Fathers,

We’ve heard your anguished cries for more storage space in the church hub, and since release, we’ve been working tirelessly to answer your prayers!

Have a look at this stash for example... This is simply no way to live. The warehouse capacity has been too damn low, we admit it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531514/3e44c5f2d3507d158bf05822bbcad0a59050ae18.png[/img]
But simply adding more storage slots? That’d be way too easy. No, we want Father to earn that extra space! So get ready to track down some practical, if slightly worn, storage solutions scattered across SULFUR. These containers can be brought back to the church to be set up and used. Some are tucked away in fixed loot spots, while others might surprise you along the way. Bring these treasures back to the Original Sin, and they’ll unlock that sweet, sweet extra stash space.

Take, for example, the humble Refrigerator:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531514/b5a423a9e7df54c37510673229ea25839b64dde4.png[/img]
This 22-cubic-foot, freon-leaking beast of an appliance has seen better days, but it’s perfect for storing an impressive stash of food…and maybe a few extra essentials. Of course, there’s no rule saying it has to be food you store inside. Father isn't picky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531514/9a91d02b8f123178132e5cb7d58fbea6fa969afc.png[/img]
This fridge, along with at least four other unlockable storage units, is now available to find in SULFUR.

From the Infinite Void™,
The SULFUR Team

notes.title: SULFUR Release Day Announced
notes.notes:
[h1]Coming to Steam October 28th 🔥 [/h1]

[h3]We are excited to announce that SULFUR will officially be entering Early Access on October 28th! We cannot wait for you to dive deeper into the game and experience everything we’ve been working on. The Early Access version will bring even more intense action, new areas, enemies, and challenges to conquer. [/h3]

[h2]DEMO Updated for Steam Next Fest [/h2]
[h3]As we approach the Early Access release of SULFUR, our focus has shifted primarily to content beyond what’s available in the demo. However, we've also made significant improvements to the overall game, and these enhancements have been incorporated into the demo as well.

[h2]Patch Notes: 0.8.0 DEMO[/h2][list]
[*] Loot Rebalancing
[*] Level Generation Optimization
[*] Graphical Optimization
[*] Enemy Balancing
[*] Better Hit Detection
[*] Audio Improvements
[*] Controller Remapping
[*] Expanded Graphics Options
[*] A plethora of smaller fixes and additions
[/list]
[b]Graphics Optimization[/b]
Switching most 2D assets from the .png format to .svg has significantly boosted SULFUR's performance on most systems.

[b]Rebalanced loot[/b]
Loot has been rebalanced across the board, affecting both enemy drops and chests. Some chests, such as Wooden/Low Tier chests, have been completely revamped and now have a chance to drop any item in the game (limited to demo items in the demo version).

[b]Improved system for level gen[/b]
Additionally, we’ve rewritten the level generation system, resulting in drastically reduced loading times. It will be even better during early access.

[b]Improved hit detection[/b]
Changes to how bullets function have improved hit detection, particularly when your gun fires multiple projectiles.

[b]Controller Remapping[/b]
We’ve also expanded the options menu to support controller remapping for both keyboard & mouse and game controllers.
[/h3]

notes.title: Demo Update - Celebrating the Rhubarb!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Demo Sulfers![/h1]

This is a special week in this part of human Earth where we celebrate Pentecost Week! 

We are being lifted from the cold, arctic darkness, now the snow is melting away, putrid stench of decaying earth hangs heavily in the air, and the first living thing is coming out the soil. The since-long-dead animals and plants are being consumed by something living green, and is the nothing but the Rhubarb! Magnificent! Its big leaves are poisonous, but the sour, tangy and stringy stems are edible, fresh, and full of vitamin C. This calls for a SULFUR Update!

The only canonical downside of Pentecost week is that the cost of pants go up, luckily there are no pants in Sulfur. *badumdish*

[b]New tasty treats with Rhubarb[/b]
[list]
[*] Rhubarb sauce
[*] Rhubarb porridge
[*] Rhubarb pie
[/list]
[h3]Rhubarb Sauce Recipe[/h3]
[list]
[*] 4 cups thinly sliced rhubarb 
[*] ½ cup white sugar 
[/list]
[b]Steps [/b]
[olist]
[*] Stir in rhubarb and sugar; 
[*] Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until tender, 5 to 10 minutes. 
[*] Hail the Rhubarb. Serve warm.
[/olist]
